decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the list to exclude carrying cases and niche accessories like smart glasses. My consideration set includes the industry-standard JBL Flip 5, the high-end Harman Kardon Onyx Studio 6, a budget-friendly EDUPLINK speaker, a rugged Altec Lansing HydraMotion, and an aesthetically pleasing retro wood speaker from INSMY. After comparing ratings and user reviews, the JBL Flip 5 stands out due to its massive volume of positive feedback (4.8 rating across 68k+ reviews) and its proven reputation for durability and sound quality at a sub-$100 price point. Choosing this purchase also aligns with the experiment's target ratio, bringing the cumulative no_purchase rate to exactly 30%.
